development_data: KIFMS V7 exact 14-review family; all outcomes are now open and may be used only for mechanism development.
forbidden_shortcuts: lower a V7 threshold or reinterpret a failed gate
drop a sparse-positive or adverse review
select a successor on KIFMS and call the same KIFMS replay confirmatory
replace the u4 donor with a weaker standalone candidate

mechanism.base: The pinned R1_L1 u4 representation and learner/balancer is mandatory.
mechanism.fallback: At every query batch the controller must be able to emit the unchanged u4 score/order when residual support is absent.
mechanism.residual: A separately normalized candidate score may alter the u4 score only under a leave-one-review-out support rule learned from the other thirteen KIFMS reviews.
mechanism.support_rule: Enable a residual configuration only if its thirteen-review mean CRE20 exceeds u4, its mean WSS95 is nonnegative relative to u4, and its worst-review R@10 delta is at least -0.05; otherwise use exact u4.
mechanism.selection: Choose the residual family and strength using nested leave-one-review-out KIFMS development only; freeze one controller before acquiring outcomes from the source-disjoint family.

motivation.scientific_diagnosis: The donor learner/balancer is useful; the standalone candidate is not. Upward progress requires absorbing the donor and adding only a safely supported residual.

next_execution.data: A lawful public review family disjoint in content and named review identity from SWIFT, SYNERGY V5 and KIFMS V7.
next_execution.estimands: CRE20 and R@10 remain coprimary; WSS95 and worst-review harm remain noncompensatory.
next_execution.minimum_units: Predeclare the complete available family; no post-outcome review selection.
required_comparators: residual ablation with the u4 base held fixed

success_condition: On the source-disjoint family, the frozen donor-envelopment controller passes both coprimary magnitude/sign rules, relative WSS95, worst-review harm and absolute work-saving gates against unchanged u4.
